KuroganeOS 5.0.0-dev — Steel / Hardware qualification candidate

This media is the Road-to-15 Steel closeout candidate. It is intended for
automated QEMU qualification first and user-side VirtualBox/physical-hardware
testing after the exact candidate matrix is green.

Implemented Steel scope:
- PCI BAR/capability hardening, MSI/MSI-X groups and I/O APIC routing;
- ACPI MADT discovery, HPET and firmware-derived FADT/DSDT reset + S5 power;
- AHCI plus writable NVMe and xHCI USB Mass Storage block backends;
- xHCI HID keyboard/mouse with bounded keyboard hotplug/ring-wrap coverage;
- Intel HDA PCM DMA with AC'97 compatibility;
- unified storage/NIC selection;
- four-vCPU AP startup, per-CPU AP state/stacks, Local APIC IPI delivery,
  cross-CPU work rendezvous and synchronous TLB shootdown.

Scope boundary:
The 5.0 SMP gate proves the multi-CPU execution substrate, not Scheduler 2.0.
Full multicore process/thread scheduling, per-CPU run queues and the wider
kernel-core redesign are 6.0 Core Steel work.

Qualification:
Do not treat this candidate as qualified 5.0 unless the exact-source Steel
Closeout, HPET, SMP, HDA, NVMe, USB Mass Storage, USB Keyboard and USB Mouse
workflows pass. VirtualBox and physical-machine observations are external
validation and must be recorded truthfully.
